judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a recognizable grey dolphin with a streamlined body, dorsal fin, and tail fluke.
requirements.note: dolphin is pale blue, not grey; dorsal fin and fluke present

requirements.text: Show a water surface below the dolphin with a large splash effect at the point where the dolphin has exited the water.
requirements.note: only a few small droplets near the tail; no large splash

requirements.text: Position the dolphin in a dynamic jumping arc, with its entire body in mid-air.
requirements.note: arc is dynamic but the tail fluke sits at the waterline

requirements.text: Draw a circular, multi-colored hula hoop, and position the dolphin so its mid-section is passing through the center of the hoop.
requirements.note: red-and-white striped ring around the mid-body

requirements.text: Include a human trainer's arm and hand extending into the frame.
requirements.note: arm and hand extend from the right

requirements.text: The trainer's hand must be holding a small fish by the tail.
requirements.note: hand grips the fish at its tail end

requirements.text: The dolphin's mouth must be depicted as wide open, just about to bite the body of the fish being held by the trainer.
requirements.note: mouth is a closed thin line
